G=load(); print(sorted(G))

code='''
def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    seen=set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                v=grid[i][j]; q=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and grid[ny][nx]==v and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                                seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                mr=min(y for y,x in cells)
                for y,x in cells: out[y-mr+1][x]=v
    return out
'''
